title: Find Steven McFellow

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: I know you. Running the old Thaddeus joint right? Nice little spot, serviced by the East and West meridian train lines. I'm also hearing rumors of plans for a new station a few minutes walk from you. A nice spot indeed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know you. Running the old Thaddeus joint right? Nice little spot, serviced by the East and West meridian train lines. I'm also hearing rumors of plans for a new station a few minutes walk from you. A nice spot indeed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You know a lot about the train network.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know a lot about the train network.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You know a lot about the train network.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You know a lot about the train network.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Everyone seems to know Thaddeus...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everyone seems to know Thaddeus...

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Pays to keep an ear to the tracks. Good to know who's eating lunch with who and how they got there. Information is its own currency.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pays to keep an ear to the tracks. Good to know who's eating lunch with who and how they got there. Information is its own currency.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have some questions about the railway.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have some questions about the railway.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have some questions about the railway.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have some questions about the railway.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Don't you all? How do I know you aren't some NATA-head looking to pawn off schedule-data for Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't you all? How do I know you aren't some NATA-head looking to pawn off schedule-data for Lims?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It sounds like you're stalking me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sounds like you're stalking me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It sounds like you're stalking me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It sounds like you're stalking me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: NATA-Head?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: NATA-Head?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have time for this, I'm trying to find the Aseptic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have time for this, I'm trying to find the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have time for this, I'm trying to find the Aseptic.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have time for this, I'm trying to find the Aseptic.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess you're just going to have to trust me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess you're just going to have to trust me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess you're just going to have to trust me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess you're just going to have to trust me.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: The Aseptic. Nasty business. According to the NATA-Log he seems to favor the Proxima line. 42% of Aseptic murders happen on that rail-line alone. Although, correlation is not causation right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Aseptic. Nasty business. According to the NATA-Log he seems to favor the Proxima line. 42% of Aseptic murders happen on that rail-line alone. Although, correlation is not causation right?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Yeah a NATA-head. Someone who takes NATA data and uses it to game the system.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah a NATA-head. Someone who takes NATA data and uses it to game the system.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: NATA Data?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: NATA Data?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Wow... Ok. I'll try and sum this up in a way you might understand. The entire rail system in Nivalis is run by two very diametrically opposed AIs. The Nivalis Autonomous Transport Authority or NATA is an ancient and mad scheduling system that is as old as the city's more crumbled foundations. Built on the old network which will be getting shut down soon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow... Ok. I'll try and sum this up in a way you might understand. The entire rail system in Nivalis is run by two very diametrically opposed AIs. The Nivalis Autonomous Transport Authority or NATA is an ancient and mad scheduling system that is as old as the city's more crumbled foundations. Built on the old network which will be getting shut down soon.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And the other AI?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And the other AI?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: The Train Route and Control Knowledge System or TRACKS. This more modern AI which is build on the modern network deciphers the mad ramblings of NATA into a schedule that humans like me can understand.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Train Route and Control Knowledge System or TRACKS. This more modern AI which is build on the modern network deciphers the mad ramblings of NATA into a schedule that humans like me can understand.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And people steal this data?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And people steal this data?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Once every four weeks, TRACKS spits out the deciphered schedule called a NATA-Log for the next month and, if you know the right people, they might be able to get their hands on said data before it becomes public knowledge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Once every four weeks, TRACKS spits out the deciphered schedule called a NATA-Log for the next month and, if you know the right people, they might be able to get their hands on said data before it becomes public knowledge.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: This sounds insane. Why does anyone care?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This sounds insane. Why does anyone care?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: This sounds insane. Why does anyone care?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: This sounds insane. Why does anyone care?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow, what a smart system.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow, what a smart system.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are train schedules so valuable?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are train schedules so valuable?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why are train schedules so valuable?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why are train schedules so valuable?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Thing is, you can do a lot with the NATA-log. You're a business owner, imagine knowing information regarding peak mid-week footfall thanks to rail disruption. Or something more sinister, like planning a heist or even a murder. Wouldn't surprise me if old Aseptic worked the rails at some stage.

Or something more sinister, like planning a heist or even a murder. Wouldn't surprise me if old Aseptic worked the rails at some stage.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the NATA-log?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the NATA-log?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: You know, I might have to. not because you look trustworthy, but because Thaddeus thinks you are. That's enough for me. I swear on the NATA-log though, if you double cross me...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, I might have to. not because you look trustworthy, but because Thaddeus thinks you are. That's enough for me. I swear on the NATA-log though, if you double cross me...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know the name Huckstash?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know the name Huckstash?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Do you know the name Huckstash?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Do you know the name Huckstash?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Huckstash, Huckstash. Haven't heard that name in many cycles. Used to roll with a rail gang. Ran it in some capacity I think. Can't have been the Invisigoths after what happened... Must be with the Crusty Punks. Yeah that sounds right. You like him for the Aseptic?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huckstash, Huckstash. Haven't heard that name in many cycles. Used to roll with a rail gang. Ran it in some capacity I think. Can't have been the Invisigoths after what happened... Must be with the Crusty Punks. Yeah that sounds right. You like him for the Aseptic?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't do bribes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't do bribes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm happy to offer a bribe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm happy to offer a bribe.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm happy to offer a bribe.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm happy to offer a bribe.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A bribe? People's lives are in danger here!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A bribe? People's lives are in danger here!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: A bribe? People's lives are in danger here!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: A bribe? People's lives are in danger here!

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: 'Bribe' is such a clunky word. Look you need something, I need something. The thing I need will lead you to the thing you need.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 'Bribe' is such a clunky word. Look you need something, I need something. The thing I need will lead you to the thing you need.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: If you wanna track down old Huckstash and his gang, you're gonna need a copy of the NATA-Log. I'd normally have it by now but my contact is a no-show. Go find it, and I'll show you how to find the old steel-dog.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you wanna track down old Huckstash and his gang, you're gonna need a copy of the NATA-Log. I'd normally have it by now but my contact is a no-show. Go find it, and I'll show you how to find the old steel-dog.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you accused me of being a NATA-head!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you accused me of being a NATA-head!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you accused me of being a NATA-head!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you accused me of being a NATA-head!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like a fair deal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like a fair deal.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: I'm what they call a Ferroequinologist. A studier of the Iron Horse. A frother, a basher. A train-spotter if you will. That log tells me where to be and when.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm what they call a Ferroequinologist. A studier of the Iron Horse. A frother, a basher. A train-spotter if you will. That log tells me where to be and when.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine. Where is your contact?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine. Where is your contact?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Out of interest, why did you want the NATA-log?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Out of interest, why did you want the NATA-log?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Out of interest, why did you want the NATA-log?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Out of interest, why did you want the NATA-log?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: I'm what they call a Ferroequinologist. A studier of the Iron Horse. A frother, a basher. A train-spotter if you will. That log tells me where to be and when.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm what they call a Ferroequinologist. A studier of the Iron Horse. A frother, a basher. A train-spotter if you will. That log tells me where to be and when.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll keep that in mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll keep that in mind.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Anything else you can tell me about this Huckstash?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anything else you can tell me about this Huckstash?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Anything else you can tell me about this Huckstash?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Anything else you can tell me about this Huckstash?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Huckstash keeps under the radar. Always has done. News on the sleepers was that he worked alone until he took over one of the railway gangs.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huckstash keeps under the radar. Always has done. News on the sleepers was that he worked alone until he took over one of the railway gangs.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Railway gangs?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Railway gangs?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds dangerous.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: You should tread carefully around Huckstash. Some say he is the mad veteran of a far-away war. Others say his whole family was killed by Roid-droids. All sound like pretty good reasons one might want to go on a deranged killing spree...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should tread carefully around Huckstash. Some say he is the mad veteran of a far-away war. Others say his whole family was killed by Roid-droids. All sound like pretty good reasons one might want to go on a deranged killing spree...

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Over the years the city has seen many gangs come and go. Normally it's young vagrants looking to live a life on the tracks. Jumping on freight trains hoping to find themselves. When these groups organize they become gangs, and it doesn't take long for them to find each other.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Over the years the city has seen many gangs come and go. Normally it's young vagrants looking to live a life on the tracks. Jumping on freight trains hoping to find themselves. When these groups organize they become gangs, and it doesn't take long for them to find each other.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's classified. Know where I can find him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's classified. Know where I can find him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's classified. Know where I can find him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's classified. Know where I can find him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He sounds like a positive lead. Know where I can find him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He sounds like a positive lead. Know where I can find him?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He sounds like a positive lead. Know where I can find him?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He sounds like a positive lead. Know where I can find him?

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Great! Not sure his exact address but he's in the stacks, goes by the name Quince Crogan. You should be able to find him easily. Follow the smell.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great! Not sure his exact address but he's in the stacks, goes by the name Quince Crogan. You should be able to find him easily. Follow the smell.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Hold on. How did you even find me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hold on. How did you even find me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: My Automata found your blog.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My Automata found your blog.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: Never mind. Back to the Crusty Punks. Remember what I said about information being its own currency?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never mind. Back to the Crusty Punks. Remember what I said about information being its own currency?

nodes.text: Great! Not sure his exact address but he's in the stacks, goes by the name Quince Crogan. You should be able to find him easily. Follow the smell.

nodes.speaker: Steven McFellow
nodes.text: It looks like I need to hide the blog better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It looks like I need to hide the blog better.

nodes.text: Huh?
